Loading libraries, set directory links, input your specific LDlink token.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(LDlinkR)
library(data.table)

ldlink_token <- "be94d998f060"

load(file = "/home/filipu/Documents/IRB/GRB/shinyApps-20210803T095940Z-001/shinyApps/Schizophrenia_precalc_tables.Rdata")

#set to directory where association and ancestries tables from GWAS catalog are located
gwas_cat_dir <- "/home/filipu/Documents/IRB/GRB/3_8_2021"

#the directory where LDproxy will output SNP correlation files 
LDout_dir <- "/home/filipu/Documents/IRB/GRB/3_8_2021/LD_link_output/schizo_test"

```


Load tables from GWAS catalog, fix column names (no spaces), keep only relevant columns.
```{r}
setwd(gwas_cat_dir)
gwas_table <- read_tsv(file = "gwas_catalog_v1.0.2-associations_e104_r2021-07-08.tsv")
ancestries_table <- read_tsv(file = "gwas-catalog-v1.0.3-ancestries-r2021-07-08.tsv")
names(gwas_table)<-make.names(names(gwas_table),unique = TRUE)
names(ancestries_table)<-make.names(names(ancestries_table),unique = TRUE)

colnames(gwas_table)
gwas_table_filtered <- select(gwas_table, STUDY, STUDY.ACCESSION, DISEASE.TRAIT, REGION, CHR_ID, CHR_POS, REPORTED.GENE.S., MAPPED_GENE, SNP_GENE_IDS, STRONGEST.SNP.RISK.ALLELE, SNPS, P.VALUE, MAPPED_TRAIT)

```


Prepare GWAS table to include only studies on european ancestry participants.
```{r}
colnames(ancestries_table)
ancestries_european <- filter(ancestries_table, BROAD.ANCESTRAL.CATEGORY == 'European')
vec_european <- pull(ancestries_european, STUDY.ACCESSION)

associations_european <- filter(gwas_table_filtered, STUDY.ACCESSION %in% vec_european)
```

Prepare list of SNPs for LDproxy
```{r}
setwd(LDout_dir)
#filter for disease--TESTING ONLY filter(associations_european, MAPPED_TRAIT == "schizophrenia") %>%
#select only relevant info, keep only unique SNPs, drop all SNPs where chromosome data is missing
snp_list_all <- associations_european %>% select(SNPS, CHR_ID) %>%
  distinct(SNPS, .keep_all = TRUE) 
#drop SNPs with no chromosome ID  
snp_list <- drop_na(snp_list_all) 
#remove CHR_ID entries that are like: 1 x 11, etc.
snp_list <- filter(snp_list, !grepl(" x ", CHR_ID))
#for CHR_IDs that are like 1;1;1, etc. keep only first characters before (;) split
snp_list$CHR_ID <- sapply(strsplit(snp_list$CHR_ID,";"), `[`, 1)
#split dataframe(snp_list) into different dataframes based on chromosome id
snp_list_chr <- split(snp_list, snp_list$CHR_ID)  

#move chromosome 6 to end of list due to highest expected number of SNPs (because of MHC locus hypervariability) 
chr_6 <- snp_list_chr["6"]
snp_list_chr["6"] <- NULL    
snp_list_chr <- c(snp_list_chr, chr_6)

#get vector with chromosome numbers
chr_vec <- c(names(snp_list_chr))
```


Run LDproxy in batch mode to get files containing lists of correlated variants from SNPs in study together with associated info.
```{r}

setwd(LDout_dir)
#run LDproxy, but save output files (tsv/txt files for each SNP) in separate directories
#for (i in 1:length(chr_vec)) {
i=10 
 dir.create(file.path(LDout_dir , chr_vec[[i]]))
  setwd(file.path(LDout_dir , chr_vec[[i]]))
  LDproxy_batch(snp =snp_list_chr[[i]]$SNPS , pop = "CEU", r2d = "r2", token = ldlink_token, append = F)
#}


```


Get all .txt files (which are actually tsv files) outputed from LDlink, combine into a table with queried snp RS-number. Separate Coord column into chromosome and loc. Remove all SNPs wit R2 lower than 0.8.
```{r}
#for (i in 1:length(chr_vec)) {
#  setwd(file.path(LDout_dir , chr_vec[[i]]))
setwd(LDout_dir)

#get paths for files, separate-out the filenames
all_paths <- list.files(path = LDout_dir, pattern = "*.txt", full.names = T, recursive = T)
all_filenames <- all_paths %>%
  basename() %>%
  as.list()

#read all output files into a single list of dataframes
all_content <- all_paths %>% 
  lapply(read.table,
         header = TRUE,
         sep = "\t",
         encoding = "UTF-8")

#append filenames to corresponding df in list of dataframes (filenames = queried SNP for each df)
all_lists <- mapply(c, all_content, all_filenames, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

#make a single dataframe from list of dataframes
all_result <- rbindlist(all_lists, fill = T)

#separate filename to remove .txt extension, remove unneccessary columns, separate Coord column into chromosome number and loc (locus coordinates on chromosome), keep only SNPs correlated with the query snp with R2 > 0.8  
all_results_0.8 <- separate(all_result, V1, c('query_snp', 'rest'), "[.]") %>%
  select(-rest, -Function) %>%
  separate(Coord, c('chromosome', 'loc'), ':') %>%
  transform(loc = as.numeric(loc)) %>%
  as.data.frame(all_results) %>% 
  filter(R2 >= 0.8)


all_results_0.8_chr <- select(all_results_0.8, query_snp, chromosome) %>%
   unique()

```

Get LD block range.
```{r}
#get table with start and end coordinates for LD block of queried SNP
range_table <- all_results_0.8 %>% 
  group_by(query_snp) %>% 
  summarize(max_loc = max(loc), min_loc = min(loc)) %>%
  left_join(all_results_0.8_chr)

#some SNPs fail the pipeline (either missing chromosome ID, or rejected by LDproxy), list the failures for further analysis
failed_snps <- setdiff(pull(snp_list_all, SNPS), pull(range_table, query_snp))
```
